# Install layout contract — bridge markers

Bridge files carry a content-free marker (path + nonce) so re-installs are idempotent and doctor can detect drift without hashing user content. A bridge whose marker is missing is treated as user-owned and left alone. The txlog records every apply step so a failed install rolls back to the pre-install snapshot deterministically.
